notes.title: New version Carpe Lucem 1.2 - now with Steam Workshop support!
notes.content:
[h1]"Carpe Lucem - Seize The Light" version 1.2 is now available[/h1]

Here are the cool new features:
[list]
[*][b]Improved level editor[/b] (Vive Motion Controller required).
[*][b]Design and exchange your own levels[/b] with other gamers through Steam Workshop. We've added two new levels there already. More puzzles under development and scheduled for release in Q4/2016. We can't wait to see the ideas the gamers come up with.[/list]

From today we're also offering a [b]demo version[/b] via Steam. The free demo allows you to try eight full levels.
